CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.srk_admin_mark_electrician_payout_paid(
  p_payout_id uuid,
  p_method text,
  p_reference text,
  p_note text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_row public.srk_electrician_payouts%rowtype;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.is_srk_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin access required' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_method IS NULL OR p_method NOT IN ('upi','bank') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payout method must be upi or bank';
  END IF;
  IF p_reference IS NULL OR pg_catalog.length(pg_catalog.btrim(p_reference)) < 4 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Valid UTR / UPI reference is required';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_row
    FROM public.srk_electrician_payouts
   WHERE id = p_payout_id
   FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payout record not found';
  END IF;
  IF v_row.payout_status <> 'pending' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only pending payouts can be marked paid';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.service_bookings b
     WHERE b.id = v_row.booking_id
       AND b.status = 'completed'
       AND b.quote_status = 'approved'
       AND b.payment_status = 'paid'
       AND b.payment_verified_at IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         (
           v_row.razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL
           AND b.razorpay_payment_id = v_row.razorpay_payment_id
         )
         OR
         (
           v_row.razorpay_payment_id IS NULL
           AND b.razorpay_payment_id IS NULL
           AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
               FROM public.srk_manual_payment_entries e
              WHERE e.booking_id = b.id
                AND pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(e.amount,0),2) =
                    pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.amount_paid,0),2)
           )
         )
       )
       AND b.assigned_electrician_id = v_row.electrician_profile_id
       AND pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.amount_paid,0),2) =
           pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.service_charge,0) + pg_catalog.coalesce(b.materials_amount,0),2)
       AND pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(v_row.gross_service_amount,0),2) =
           pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.service_charge,0),2)
       AND pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(v_row.materials_amount,0),2) =
           pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.materials_amount,0),2)
       AND pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(v_row.platform_commission,0),2) =
           pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.service_charge,0) * b.commission_rate / 100,2)
       AND pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(v_row.electrician_payable,0),2) =
           pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.service_charge,0) + pg_catalog.coalesce(b.materials_amount,0)
             - pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.coalesce(b.service_charge,0) * b.commission_rate / 100,2),2)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Booking payment or payout ledger does not match verified booking; payout blocked';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.srk_electrician_payouts
     SET payout_status = 'paid',
         payout_method = p_method,
         payout_reference = pg_catalog.btrim(p_reference),
         payout_note = pg_catalog.nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_note),''),
         paid_by = auth.uid(),
         paid_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
   WHERE id = p_payout_id;
  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'payout_id', p_payout_id, 'status', 'paid');
END;
$function$;

-- Secure full Razorpay refund intent and reconciliation workflow.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.srk_razorpay_refunds (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.service_bookings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payment_id text NOT NULL CHECK (payment_id ~ '^pay_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'),
  refund_id text UNIQUE CHECK (refund_id IS NULL OR refund_id ~ '^rfnd_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'),
  amount numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0 AND amount <= 10000000),
  amount_paise bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise > 0 AND amount_paise <= 1000000000),
  currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR' CHECK (currency='INR'),
  idempotency_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 10 AND 36),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested' CHECK (status IN ('requested','processing','unknown','processed','failed')),
  provider_status text,
  reason text NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 20 AND 250),
  admin_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  previous_payout_note text,
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  processed_at timestamptz
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS srk_razorpay_refunds_status_idx ON public.srk_razorpay_refunds(status,created_at DESC);
ALTER TABLE public.srk_razorpay_refunds ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.srk_razorpay_refunds FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE ON TABLE public.srk_razorpay_refunds TO service_role;

ALTER TABLE public.srk_razorpay_webhook_events
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS razorpay_refund_id text;

ALTER TABLE public.srk_admin_audit_events
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS srk_admin_audit_events_entity_type_check;
ALTER TABLE public.srk_admin_audit_events
  ADD CONSTRAINT srk_admin_audit_events_entity_type_check
  CHECK (entity_type IN ('booking','electrician_profile','electrician_application','manual_payment','manual_refund','electrician_payout','razorpay_refund'));

create or replace function public.srk_get_my_offer_price_details()
returns table (
  offer_id uuid,
  booking_id uuid,
  offer_status text,
  customer_suggested_amount numeric,
  electrician_quote_kind text,
  service_charge numeric,
  materials_amount numeric,
  quote_status text,
  quote_note text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $function$
  select
    o.id,
    b.id,
    o.status,
    b.customer_suggested_amount,
    b.electrician_quote_kind,
    case when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id then b.service_charge else null end,
    case when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id then b.materials_amount else null end,
    case when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id then b.quote_status else null end,
    case when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id then b.quote_note else null end
  from public.job_offers o
  join public.electrician_profiles p on p.id = o.electrician_id
  join public.service_bookings b on b.id = o.booking_id
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and (p.user_id = auth.uid() or p.auth_user_id = auth.uid())
    and p.verification_status = 'approved'
    and p.active = true
  order by o.created_at desc
  limit 100;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.srk_get_my_offer_price_details() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_get_my_offer_price_details() to authenticated;

returns table (
  booking_id uuid,
  service_type text,
  state text,
  district text,
  pincode text,
  booking_status text,
  quoted_amount numeric,
  service_charge numeric,
  materials_amount numeric,
  quote_status text,
  quote_note text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $function$
  select b.id, b.service_type, b.state, b.district, b.pincode, b.status,
         b.quoted_amount, b.service_charge, b.materials_amount,
         b.quote_status, b.quote_note
    from public.electrician_profiles p
    join public.service_bookings b on b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
   where auth.uid() is not null
     and (p.user_id = auth.uid() or p.auth_user_id = auth.uid())
     and p.verification_status = 'approved'
     and p.active = true
     and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','quote_rejected','in_progress','completed')
   order by b.created_at desc
   limit 100;
$function$;
revoke all on function public.srk_get_my_assigned_booking_quote_details() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_get_my_assigned_booking_quote_details() to authenticated;

create or replace function public.srk_submit_booking_quote(
  p_booking_id uuid,
  p_service_charge numeric,
  p_materials_amount numeric,
  p_quote_note text default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $function$
declare
  v_profile_id uuid;
  v_booking public.service_bookings%rowtype;
  v_total numeric(12,2);
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;
  if p_booking_id is null or p_service_charge is null or p_service_charge <= 0
     or p_materials_amount is null or p_materials_amount < 0
     or p_service_charge > 10000000 or p_materials_amount > 10000000 then
    raise exception 'Invalid quote amounts';
  end if;

  select id into v_profile_id
    from public.electrician_profiles
   where (user_id = auth.uid() or auth_user_id = auth.uid())
     and verification_status = 'approved' and active = true
   order by created_at desc limit 1;

  if v_profile_id is null then raise exception 'Approved active electrician required'; end if;

  select * into v_booking from public.service_bookings
   where id = p_booking_id and assigned_electrician_id = v_profile_id
   for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'Assigned booking not found'; end if;
  if v_booking.status not in ('assigned','inspection','quote_rejected') then
    raise exception 'Booking is not ready for a quote';
  end if;

  v_total := round(p_service_charge + p_materials_amount, 2);
  update public.service_bookings
     set service_charge = round(p_service_charge, 2),
         materials_amount = round(p_materials_amount, 2),
         quoted_amount = v_total,
         quote_note = left(coalesce(p_quote_note, ''), 1000),
         quote_status = 'pending',
         quote_submitted_at = pg_catalog.now(),
         quote_responded_at = null,
         status = 'awaiting_quote_approval'
   where id = p_booking_id;

  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'total', v_total, 'quote_status', 'pending');
end;
$function$;
revoke all on function public.srk_submit_booking_quote(uuid,numeric,numeric,text) from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_submit_booking_quote(uuid,numeric,numeric,text) to authenticated;

create or replace function public.srk_customer_get_my_booking_contacts()
returns table(booking_id uuid, electrician_phone text, booking_status text)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $$
  select b.id, ep.phone, b.status
  from public.service_bookings b
  join public.electrician_profiles ep on ep.id = b.assigned_electrician_id
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and b.customer_user_id = auth.uid()
    and b.assigned_electrician_id is not null
    and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','quote_rejected','in_progress','completed')
    and ep.verification_status = 'approved'
    and ep.active = true
  order by b.created_at desc
  limit 100;
$$;

create or replace function public.srk_electrician_get_my_assigned_booking_contacts()
returns table(booking_id uuid, customer_phone text, booking_status text)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $$
  select b.id, b.phone, b.status
  from public.electrician_profiles ep
  join public.service_bookings b on b.assigned_electrician_id = ep.id
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and (ep.user_id = auth.uid() or ep.auth_user_id = auth.uid())
    and ep.verification_status = 'approved'
    and ep.active = true
    and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','quote_rejected','in_progress','completed')
  order by b.created_at desc
  limit 100;
$$;

revoke all on function public.srk_customer_get_my_booking_contacts() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_customer_get_my_booking_contacts() to authenticated;
revoke all on function public.srk_electrician_get_my_assigned_booking_contacts() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_electrician_get_my_assigned_booking_contacts() to authenticated;
